profile.name: Rosenbauer International AG
profile.summary: Rosenbauer International AG engages in the provision of systems for preventive firefighting and disaster protection technology worldwide. It develops, produces, and sells a portfolio vehicle, fire extinguishing systems, equipment, and digital solutions for professional, industrial, plant and volunteer fire services. The company offers municipal, ARFF, and industrial and aerial rescue vehicles; aerial ladders and hydraulic firefighting, refurbishment, and rescue platforms; and intervention and limber hose reels, light masts, compartment shutters, logic control systems, roll-on/roll-off containers, and stowage systems. It also provides firefighting helmets and gloves; protective clothing and boots; power generators; fans; submersible pumps; thermal imaging cameras; nozzles; LED lighting systems; HAZMAT and decon equipment; alarms and warning devices; fittings, couplings, and proportioners; respiratory and chemical protection, and measurement technology; firefighting devices and extinguishing agents; fire station equipment; gift articles; sanitary and rescue equipment; and hoses. In addition, it offers portable pumps, ultra-high-pressure systems, POLY extinguishing systems, truck-mounted pumps, foam proportioning systems, compressed air foam systems, nozzles and monitors, turrets, and engine-pump units; DRILL-X, a drilling and extinguishing device; Rosenbauer Technical Equipment (RTE) Robot, robots for fire departments and emergency services; RFC battery extinguishing systems; RFC CUTTEX, a cutting and extinguishing system; digital solutions; CAFS, turret, and POLY extinguishing systems, tunnel protection systems; and water, gas, and kitchen extinguishing systems. Further, the company provides spare parts, and repair and general overhaul services, as well as rents vehicles and equipment. The company was founded in 1866 and is headquartered in Leonding, Austria. Rosenbauer International AG operates as a subsidiary of Rosenbauer Beteiligungsverwaltung GmbH.
profile.summary_fr: Rosenbauer International AG s'engage dans la fourniture de systèmes pour la prévention des incendies et la technologie de protection contre les catastrophes dans le monde entier. Elle développe, produit et vend un portefeuille de véhicules, de systèmes d'extinction d'incendie, d'équipements et de solutions numériques pour les services d'incendie professionnels, industriels, d'usine et bénévoles. La société propose des véhicules de sauvetage municipaux, ARFF et industriels et aériens; échelles aériennes et plates-formes hydrauliques de lutte contre les incendies, de remise à neuf et de sauvetage; et enrouleurs de tuyaux d'intervention et de flexibles, mâts légers, volets de compartiment, systèmes de contrôle logique, conteneurs roll-on / roll-off et systèmes d'arrimage.
